answer_1.quote: This study investigates the effectiveness of paraphrases for the AMR-to-text generation task in Brazilian Portuguese.
answer_1.outputs: natural language sentences from Abstract Meaning Representation graphs

answer_2.quote: We report the results for each approach and each paraphrase selection criterion, training the models under the setting T. In general, we report BLEU, METEOR, chrF++, and BERTScore

answer_4.quote: To gain insights into some results, we conduct a manual revision. We select 112 instances from the development set to identify the primary mistakes and phenomena generated by the models.
answer_4.guideline: We define two categories in the evaluation: valid and invalid outputs. Valid outputs are further divided into three sub-categories: 'equivalent', 'semantic', and 'syntactic'. Invalid outputs include 3 sub-categories: 'missing', 'partial hallucination', and 'total hallucination'.
